mapper.select: SELECT id, log_date, system_code, metric_value, target_value, done, note FROM habit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_date = #{date} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, log_date, system_code, metric_value, target_value, done, note FROM habit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habit_log(user_id, log_date, system_code, metric_value, target_value, done, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{log.logDate}, #{log.systemCode}, COALESCE(#{log.metricValue}, 0), #{log.targetValue}, COALESCE(#{log.done}, FALSE), #{log.note}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, log_date, system_code) DO UPDATE SET metric_value = EXCLUDED.metric_value, target_value = EXCLUDED.target_value, done = EXCLUDED.done, note = EXCLUDED.note, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT system_code AS "systemCode", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE done = TRUE) AS "doneDays", COUNT(*) AS "loggedDays", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "totalValue" FROM habit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY system_code
